intro: Jaipur is one of those places that stays with you long after the trip ends. The Pink City of forts, palaces and bazaars — and it is easier to plan than you might think.

sections.heading: Why visit Jaipur
paragraphs: Jaipur (Rajasthan) is known for its heritage, city and shopping experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to March.

sections.heading: Top things to do
list: Amber Fort early in the morning

sections.heading: How to get there
paragraphs: Jaipur has an international airport and frequent trains and buses from Delhi (about 5 hours by road).

sections.heading: Where to stay
list: Bani Park for quieter boutique hotels

sections.heading: Insider tip
paragraphs: Buy the composite ticket — it covers most major monuments and saves money.

faq.q: When is the best time to visit Jaipur?

faq.a: Jaipur has an international airport and frequent trains and buses from Delhi (about 5 hours by road).

faq.q: Where should I stay in Jaipur?
faq.a: Popular choices: C-Scheme for central, upscale stays; Old City for heritage havelis; Bani Park for quieter boutique hotels.
